hook.es: ¿Por qué tenemos que empezar de cero cada vez?
hook.en: Why do we have to start from zero every time?

objective: The Traveler formalizes a company around cloud/DevOps consulting and client work. Across many different clients, the same underlying patterns keep repeating — the question shifts from 'how do we build this project' to 'why do we rebuild the same pieces every time.'

metadata.call_to_action: Los mismos patrones, una y otra vez.

captions.es: Cada cliente distinto. Los mismos patrones debajo.
captions.en: Every client different. The same patterns underneath.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler surrounded by many small distinct client-world fragments, each one revealing the same glowing pattern underneath

notes: Act IV of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.
Theme: recognizing repetition as signal, not coincidence — the first hint of a reusable platform hiding inside years of one-off consulting work.
Emotional conflict: professional competence (billable client work) starting to feel insufficient against a bigger, still-unnamed idea.
Visual motif: repeating pattern (usuario, lead, cliente, workflow, notificación, pago, dashboard, integración) glowing faintly under many different client-world skins.

Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 04. IntCloudSysOps is a real company; keep this episode strictly about the pattern-recognition realization, not specific client names or figures.
Chronologically precedes Episode 5 (The Blueprint) — this is the seed, Blueprint is the naming of it.
